name: swatch-picker
title: Swatch Picker
description: Colour swatches with a ring that glides to your pick, a small squeeze and a check in readable ink.

perf.budget: Plain views; one ring on two shared values and two per swatch for the squeeze and check. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The ring jumps to the new swatch and the check appears without a spring.
a11y.screenReader: A radio group named by accessibilityLabel; each swatch is a radio read by its label.
a11y.touchTarget: Each swatch is the centre of a 44 by 44 pt cell.
